metadata.description: Topical authority, E-E-A-T framework, brand mentions, entity consistency
metadata.per_source_detail: The per-source detail gathered while building this skill is not redistributed; this list links to the originals.

topical_authority.definition: The perception that a website or brand is the definitive expert on a specific subject area, established through comprehensive, interconnected content coverage
topical_authority.importance: AI systems prioritize authoritative sources when selecting content for answer generation

hub_and_spoke_model.hub_page: Comprehensive pillar content covering broad topic overview (3,000-5,000+ words)
hub_and_spoke_model.spoke_pages: Detailed subtopic pages (1,500-2,500 words each) linking back to hub
hub_and_spoke_model.internal_linking: Robust cross-linking between hub and spokes to signal topical relationship
hub_and_spoke_model.content_depth: Minimum 10-15 interconnected pieces per topic cluster

implementation_framework.comprehensive_coverage: Address topic from every relevant angle, answering all related questions
implementation_framework.content_freshness: Regular updates to maintain currency and relevance
implementation_framework.semantic_connections: Use topic modeling and entity relationships to demonstrate subject mastery

topical_authority.measurement: Track domain authority, subject-specific keyword rankings, and citation frequency in AI answers

eeat_framework.aeo_importance: AI systems evaluate E-E-A-T signals when selecting sources for authoritative answers

components.definition: Demonstrable first-hand, real-world experience with the topic
implementation: Include author credentials and practical experience in bylines
Share case studies, experiments, and original research
Document real-world applications and results
Use first-person narrative when appropriate

components.definition: Depth of knowledge and skill in a particular field
implementation: Highlight author qualifications, certifications, and education
Reference professional affiliations and industry recognition
Demonstrate technical knowledge through detailed explanations
Include expert contributors and interview industry leaders

components.definition: Recognition as a leading voice or source in the subject area
implementation: Earn citations and backlinks from other authoritative sources
Build brand mentions across reputable platforms
Develop Wikipedia presence for brand and key contributors
Secure media coverage and industry awards

components.definition: Accuracy, honesty, and safety of content and website
implementation: Maintain HTTPS security across all pages
Display clear privacy policies and terms of service
Provide transparent contact information and author details
Fact-check all claims and cite authoritative sources
Correct errors promptly and transparently

brand_mentions_off_site_signals.definition: References to brand name, products, or key personnel across external websites, even without direct backlinks
brand_mentions_off_site_signals.aeo_importance: AI systems use unlinked brand mentions as authority signals when compiling answers

strategic_approach.earned_media: Secure mentions in industry publications, news outlets, and authoritative blogs
strategic_approach.thought_leadership: Contribute guest posts, expert quotes, and interviews to establish subject matter expertise
strategic_approach.social_proof: Build mentions across social media platforms, forums, and community discussions
strategic_approach.wikipedia_presence: Create and maintain accurate Wikipedia entries for brand and key products/people
strategic_approach.ugc_platforms: Encourage authentic mentions on user-generated content sites (Reddit, Quora, review platforms)

brand_mentions_off_site_signals.geo_tactic: Consistently publish content around brand-related topics and earn credible mentions across the web
brand_mentions_off_site_signals.measurement: Track brand mention volume, sentiment, and context using tools like Atomic AGI, Writesonic AI Visibility Tool

entity_consistency.definition: Uniform Name, Address, Phone (NAP) data and entity information across all online properties
entity_consistency.importance: Consistent entity data helps AI systems accurately identify and reference brands
implementation: Maintain identical NAP across website, Google Business Profile, social media, directories
Use Organization and LocalBusiness schema markup with complete entity data
Create and maintain Knowledge Graph entities through structured data
Ensure consistent brand naming, product names, and terminology across all content
